build_linear_kernel: build a python module to instantiate AWQAscendLinearKernel with a quantization config for NPU linear layer inference
process_linear_weights: process AWQ quantized linear layer weights after loading by repacking qweights and converting qzeros to NPU layout
apply_linear_forward: apply the AWQAscendLinearKernel forward pass using npu_weight_quant_batchmatmul on a quantized linear layer with optional bias
build_moe_kernel: build a python module to instantiate AWQAscendMoEKernel with a quantization config for NPU mixture-of-experts inference
process_moe_weights: process AWQ quantized MoE layer weights after loading by converting w13 and w2 qweights and qzeros to NPU layout
